shortDescription: Create, update or destroy reverse_proxy location entry in Sophos UTM

options.name: access_control
options.description: Whether to activate the access control for the location.

options.name: allowed_networks
options.description: A list of allowed networks.

options.name: auth_profile
options.description: The reference name of the auth profile.

options.name: backend
options.description: A list of backends that are connected with this location declaration.

options.name: be_path
options.description: The path of the backend.

options.name: comment
options.description: The optional comment string.

options.name: denied_networks
options.description: A list of denied network references.

options.name: headers
options.description: A dictionary of additional headers to be sent to POST and PUT requests. Is needed for some modules.

options.name: hot_standby
options.description: Activate hot standby mode.

options.name: name
options.description: The name of the object that identifies the entry.

options.name: path
options.description: The path of the location.

options.name: state
options.description: The desired state of the object. V(present) creates or updates an object. V(absent) deletes an object if present.

options.name: status
options.description: Whether the location is active or not.

options.name: stickysession_id
options.description: The stickysession ID.

options.name: stickysession_status
options.description: Enable the stickysession.

options.name: utm_host
options.description: The REST Endpoint of the Sophos UTM.

options.name: utm_port
options.description: The port of the REST interface.

options.name: utm_protocol
options.description: The protocol of the REST Endpoint.

options.name: utm_token
options.description: The token used to identify at the REST-API. See U(https://www.sophos.com/en-us/medialibrary/PDFs/documentation/UTMonAWS/Sophos-UTM-RESTful-API.pdf?la=en), Chapter 2.4.2.

options.name: validate_certs
options.description: Whether the REST interface's SSL certificate should be verified or not.

options.name: websocket_passthrough
options.description: Enable the websocket passthrough.
